user.title: Set up your garden
user.description: Plant Garden adds a garden planner to the sidebar. AI providers and weather sources can be added later.

data_description.garden_name: Shown in the sidebar and on the garden device.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Plant Garden is already set up.

data.ai_budget_stop: Stop AI calls when the budget is used up
data.usd_eur: Fixed rate US dollar to euro (0 = show dollars)
data.ai_debug: Store prompts and answers in the AI log

data_description.max_runtime_hours: If an irrigation zone runs longer, a notice appears under Repairs (e.g. a stuck valve).
data_description.ai_budget: In euros when a rate is set, else in US dollars. A notice appears at 80 %.
data_description.ai_debug: For troubleshooting only; prompts can contain plant details.
data_description.ai_retention_days: Older calls are kept as daily sums.

long_run.title: Irrigation zone {zone} has been running for {hours} h
long_run.description: {entity} has been on for {hours} hours. Check whether the valve is stuck. Plant Garden never switches anything itself. This notice disappears once the zone is off again.

budget_warning.title: 80 % of the monthly AI budget used
budget_warning.description: Plant Garden has spent {spent} of {budget} {currency} on AI this month.

budget_exceeded.title: Monthly AI budget used up
budget_exceeded.description: Plant Garden has spent {spent} of {budget} {currency} on AI this month. With the stop option on, no more AI calls are made until next month.

not_loaded.message: Plant Garden is not set up.

not_plant_or_zone.message: {device_id} is neither a plant nor an irrigation zone of Plant Garden.

liters_needed.message: Please give the litres for plants.

minutes_needed.message: Please give the minutes for irrigation zones.

no_photos.message: This plant has no photos yet.

log_watering.name: Log watering
log_watering.description: Records water that Plant Garden did not see itself: litres per plant (watering can) or minutes for a zone (e.g. with the hose).

device_id.name: Plants or zones
device_id.description: Plant Garden devices: plants and/or irrigation zones.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Run time for each selected zone; the amount follows from the zone's precipitation rate.

refresh_weather.name: Refresh weather
refresh_weather.description: Fetches the weather now (otherwise hourly) and recalculates the water balance.

identify_plant.name: Identify plant
identify_plant.description: Identifies a plant from its newest photos with the configured AI (costs tokens). The suggestions appear on the plant page.

photos.name: Photos
photos.description: How many of the newest photos (1 to 3).

user.title: Weather source
user.description: Rain and evaporation drive the water balance of your plants. Your own sensors win over weather services; services fill the gaps and bring the forecast.

service.title: {service}
service.description: {service} receives the rounded location of the garden ({latitude}, {longitude}, about 1 km) every hour, nothing else. Submit to test the connection.

sensors.title: Your own sensors
sensors.description: Past days come from the long-term statistics, so the sensors need a state class. Rain and ET₀ may be counters or daily values. Choose at least one.

error.cannot_connect: The service did not answer with weather data for this place.
error.no_sensor: Please choose at least one sensor or a weather entity.

abort.already_configured: This weather service is already added.

user.title: AI provider
user.description: AI identifies plants from photos and suggests care. It is only called when you start it. What is sent: the photos you choose, the plant's details (name, category, your notes are not included) and the season with the hemisphere. Never your exact location, names of people or Home Assistant entity ids. Every call is logged with tokens and costs on the tech page.

ai_task.title: Home Assistant AI Task
ai_task.description: Uses an AI already set up in Home Assistant (no key of its own). It reports no tokens, so costs show as unknown.

openai.title: OpenAI-compatible service
openai.description: OpenAI, OpenRouter (reports the cost of every call), Ollama or LM Studio on your network, or any other OpenAI-compatible server.

data.api_key: API key (not needed for local servers)

key.title: {provider}
key.description: The key is stored in Home Assistant and never shown again. It is checked with a call that costs nothing.

model.title: Model
model.description: Choose a model that understands photos. You can assign providers to features in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: The service could not be reached or answered with an error.
error.invalid_url: Please enter an http:// or https:// address.

options.bright_sky: Bright Sky – German Weather Service DWD (Germany, no key)
options.home_assistant: My own sensors in Home Assistant

options.ha_ai_task: Home Assistant AI Task (uses an AI integration you already have)
options.plantnet: Pl@ntNet (species identification only, 500 free per day)
